title: Yessex
html_source: It’s not incidental that bloom is thinking “Yes sex” here, and that in this chapter he crosses the bridge that will allow him to soon say “yes” to joyous, unsullied, romantic, connubial sex with Molly. Such chaste, married love is depicted in the lyrics of The Bloom is on the Rye
